'''Revenant Armor''' is an {{Epic}} [[Armor]] Set unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer|4}}. It focuses on healing and {{Stat|def}} against {{MobSprite|Zombie;Zombies}}.

Although crafting a '''Revenant Chestplate''' requires {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer|5}}, only {{CollectionLink|Zombie Slayer|4}} is needed to use it. It is an {{Undead}} armor set and therefore affected by the {{Item|Zombie Pet}}'s {{AN|Living Dead}} perk.

=== Crafting ===
{{Crafting Usage|Revenant Chestplate|Revenant Leggings|Revenant Boots}}
The [[Healing Wand]] bonus requires the set to have been worn for at least {{Green|3}} seconds to activate.

== Tips ==
* Farming low level {{MobSprite|Zombie}}s in the {{zone|Graveyard}} is an easy way to increase the kill counter on {{AN|Zombie Bulwark}}.
* Donating this item in the {{zone|Museum}} grants both the {{Item|Zombie Armor}} and {{Item|Revenant Armor}} credit, despite not using Zombie Armor in the crafting recipe.

== Trivia ==
*In version v0.7.7, the '''Revenant Boots''' recipe was bugged, requiring an additional {{Item|Revenant Viscera|amount=16}} on the bottom-right of the crafting recipe. 
*'''Revenant Leggings''' used to be chainmail before changing to diamond during the Reforge Update.
